answer: Proof-of-Stake thwarts Sybil attacks in AI economies by requiring agents to stake valuable tokens. An attacker needs to acquire and lock substantial capital, akin to claiming a vast, desolate tundra; the sheer economic cost becomes prohibitive. Each staked token provides a verifiable signal of legitimate participation. To gain significant control, an attacker faces an overwhelming economic tide of capital expenditure, making a Sybil attack economically infeasible.
